<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>ORBIT</title><style>html,body{margin:0;background:#000;overflow:hidden}canvas{display:block;width:100vw;height:auto}</style></head><body><canvas id="stage" width="1920" height="1080"></canvas><script>
window.DURATION=10;
const cv=document.getElementById('stage'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d'),W=1920,H=1080;
const img=new Image();img.src=window.ASSETS['test-orbit'];
window.READY=Promise.all([img.decode()]);
const OR='#ff6a3d',FONT='-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif';
const cl=x=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x));
const pr=(t,a,b)=>cl((t-a)/(b-a));
const eo=x=>1-Math.pow(1-x,3);
const eio=x=>x<.5?4*x*x*x:1-Math.pow(-2*x+2,3)/2;
const lerp=(a,b,p)=>a+(b-a)*p;
const K=[
{t:1.8,fx:480,fy:320,sx:960,sy:820,s:1.0,k:.38,a:0,r:-.06},
{t:3.4,fx:480,fy:320,sx:960,sy:540,s:1.36,k:0,a:1,r:0},
{t:4.5,fx:480,fy:320,sx:960,sy:540,s:1.44,k:0,a:1,r:0},
{t:6.0,fx:275,fy:400,sx:700,sy:560,s:2.75,k:0,a:1,r:0},
{t:7.4,fx:275,fy:400,sx:690,sy:560,s:2.88,k:0,a:1,r:0},
{t:8.6,fx:480,fy:320,sx:560,sy:560,s:.8,k:-.12,a:1,r:.0},
{t:10,fx:480,fy:320,sx:560,sy:560,s:.84,k:-.12,a:1,r:0}];
function cam(t){if(t<=K[0].t)return Object.assign({},K[0]);for(let i=0;i<K.length-1;i++){const A=K[i],B=K[i+1];if(t<=B.t){let p=(t-A.t)/(B.t-A.t);p=(i==0)?eo(p):eio(p);const o={};for(const k in A)o[k]=lerp(A[k],B[k],p);return o;}}return Object.assign({},K[K.length-1]);}
function rr(x,y,w,h,r){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);ctx.closePath();}
function font(sz,wt){ctx.font=wt+' '+sz+'px '+FONT;}
function fit(txt,sz,wt,maxW){font(sz,wt);let w=ctx.measureText(txt).width;if(w>maxW){sz=Math.floor(sz*maxW/w);font(sz,wt);}return sz;}
function maskLine(txt,x,y,sz,wt,col,p,align){ctx.save();ctx.textAlign=align||'left';ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';font(sz,wt);const w=ctx.measureText(txt).width;let lx=align==='center'?x-w/2:x;ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(lx-20,y-sz*1.05,w+40,sz*1.35);ctx.clip();ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillText(txt,x,y+(1-eo(p))*sz*1.3);ctx.restore();}
function bg(t){ctx.fillStyle='#050505';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const gx=lerp(400,1500,t/10),gy=540+Math.sin(t*.6)*120;const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(gx,gy,0,gx,gy,900);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,106,61,0.16)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,106,61,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';const off=(t*18)%60;for(let x=0;x<W+60;x+=60)for(let y=0;y<H+60;y+=60){ctx.fillRect(x-off,y,2,2);}}
function drawDash(t){if(t<1.8)return;const c=cam(t);if(c.a<=0)return;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=c.a;ctx.translate(c.sx,c.sy);ctx.rotate(c.r);ctx.transform(1,c.k*.22,0,1-Math.abs(c.k)*.35,0,0);ctx.scale(c.s,c.s);ctx.translate(-c.fx,-c.fy);ctx.save();ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,106,61,0.35)';ctx.shadowBlur=60/Math.max(c.s,.5);ctx.fillStyle='#14151a';rr(40,40,880,560,24);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();ctx.save();rr(0,0,960,640,30);ctx.clip();ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,960,640);ctx.restore();
const bars=[[105,442],[160,400],[215,425],[270,350],[325,373],[380,315]];if(t>5.6&&t<7.9){const fade=1-pr(t,7.4,7.9);bars.forEach((b,i)=>{const p=eo(pr(t,5.7+i*.12,6.1+i*.12));if(p<=0)return;const top=lerp(500,b[1],p);ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=c.a*fade;ctx.strokeStyle=OR;ctx.lineWidth=2.2;ctx.shadowColor=OR;ctx.shadowBlur=14;rr(b[0]-4,top-4,39,500-top+8,6);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();});const sp=pr(t,5.8,7.2);if(sp>0&&sp<1){const y=lerp(510,300,eio(sp));ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=c.a*fade*Math.sin(sp*Math.PI);const lg=ctx.createLinearGradient(85,0,465,0);lg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,106,61,0)');lg.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(255,140,100,1)');lg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,106,61,0)');ctx.fillStyle=lg;ctx.fillRect(85,y,380,1.6);ctx.restore();}}
ctx.restore();}
function scene1(t){if(t>2.6)return;const out=eio(pr(t,1.8,2.5));ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=1-out;ctx.translate(0,-out*140);font(30,'600');ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha*=eo(pr(t,.05,.5));ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.letterSpacing='12px';ctx.fillText('ORBIT',W/2+6,330);ctx.restore();const s1=fit('Your work,',160,'700',W*.8);maskLine('Your work,',W/2,520,s1,'700','#ffffff',pr(t,.15,.75),'center');maskLine('in motion.',W/2,700,s1,'700',OR,pr(t,.45,1.05),'center');const lp=eio(pr(t,.7,1.5));ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.fillRect(W/2-300*lp,760,600*lp,6);ctx.restore();}
function scene3(t){if(t<5.4||t>7.9)return;const a=eo(pr(t,5.5,6.1))*(1-pr(t,7.3,7.8));const x=1350,mw=W*.94-x;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=a;const dx=(1-eo(pr(t,5.5,6.2)))*60;ctx.translate(dx,0);font(26,'600');ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.letterSpacing='6px';ctx.fillText('THIS WEEK',x,420);ctx.letterSpacing='0px';const sz=fit('made visible.',72,'700',mw);maskLine('Momentum,',x,520,sz,'700','#fff',pr(t,5.6,6.2));maskLine('made visible.',x,610,sz,'700','#fff',pr(t,5.8,6.4));const lp=eio(pr(t,6.1,6.8));ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.fillRect(x,650,160*lp,5);font(28,'400');ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.65)';ctx.globalAlpha=a*eo(pr(t,6.3,6.9));ctx.fillText('Every bar, every day.',x,710);ctx.restore();}
function scene4(t){if(t<8.0)return;const x=1110,mw=W*.94-x;ctx.save();font(26,'600');ctx.globalAlpha=eo(pr(t,8.1,8.6));ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.letterSpacing='10px';ctx.fillText('ORBIT',x,380);ctx.letterSpacing='0px';ctx.globalAlpha=1;const sz=fit('Start your next',96,'700',mw);maskLine('Start your next',x,500,sz,'700','#fff',pr(t,8.2,8.8));maskLine('big idea.',x,500+sz*1.12,sz,'700',OR,pr(t,8.4,9.0));const ly=500+sz*1.12+44;const lp=eio(pr(t,8.8,9.5));ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.fillRect(x,ly,mw*.55*lp,6);ctx.globalAlpha=eo(pr(t,9.0,9.6));font(30,'400');ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';ctx.fillText('Your work, in motion.',x,ly+70);ctx.restore();}
function wipe(t){const p=pr(t,7.25,7.75);if(p<=0||p>=1)return;const x=lerp(-W*.3,W*1.1,eio(p));ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.sin(p*Math.PI)*.5;const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(x-200,0,x+200,0);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,106,61,0)');g.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(255,106,61,0.6)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,106,61,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(x-200,0,400,H);ctx.restore();}
window.seek=async function(t){await window.READY;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(10,+t||0));ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.shadowColor='transparent';ctx.letterSpacing='0px';ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';bg(t);drawDash(t);scene1(t);scene3(t);scene4(t);wipe(t);ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';ctx.fillRect(0,H-6,W,6);ctx.fillStyle=OR;ctx.fillRect(0,H-6,W*t/10,6);};
</script></body></html>
